elements.element: The transition obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 14a applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

Section 14a(a) states that TrueLink “shall ... provide transition assistance.” The customer-request condition is consistent with assistance being provided when needed and remains within Client's control.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(a) expressly requires assistance “for up to six (6) months following such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.

elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires TrueLink to “return all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control.”

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires return “within thirty (30) days following such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires return in a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(c) requires TrueLink, “after such return,” to delete the Client Content and Client data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(c) requires TrueLink to “certify such deletion to Client in writing” after return.

elements.element: The fallback transition obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 14a applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
Section 14a(a) expressly obligates TrueLink to provide transition assistance at Client's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The required availability of up to six months encompasses the fallback period of 90 days.
The obligation to return all Client Content and other Client data in a commonly used, machine-readable format satisfies the data-export requirement.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) expressly requires the data return within thirty days following expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative redline fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It covers both expiry and termination, provides up to six months of requested transition assistance at then-current rates, mandates return of all Client data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and requires subsequent deletion and written certification. The new section is targeted to transition and data-return obligations and does not disturb the existing term, termination, ownership, or migration provisions.
